title: Follow the selection
description: A panel that shows the selected text and its word count, updated each time a selection is made, in any editor.
shows: initDataType "text": the editor hands the selected text to init
initOnSelectionChanged: init runs again when a selection is made (not when it is cleared)
isViewer: the panel is offered in read-only documents too
executeMethod GetSelectedText with options, for a fresh read on demand
